title: HandmadeCon 2015 - Pat Wyatt
summary: Pat Wyatt, a veteran game programmer who worked at Blizzard and ArenaNet, speaks at HandmadeCon 2015 in a conversation with Casey Muratori. He discusses network code and architecture in games he worked on, including mistakes on Diablo and the success of Guild Wars.
why: HN points to it as a first-hand account of game netcode and engineering lessons from a Blizzard and Guild Wars developer.

quote.text: good interview with him talking about screwing up Diablo and doing a good job on Guild Wars
